title: Produce a literal violating prior pair without a matrix-log oracle
statement: Given c*r_i<1, rational support bounds a,b and h with2^h>=8/(a*b), choose k=max(h,floor(c*h/(1-c*r_i))+1), epsilon=2^-k. The scalar-reference hypotheses p_i=1 and q_i=epsilon,q_j=(1-epsilon)/(n-1) violate the claimed reverse factor. Kernel/pseudoinverse bounds are supplied by rational elimination. The explicit denominator needs k+1bits; compressed exponent notation does not erase eventual preparation cost. Optional strictly faithful mixing requires extra precision not quantified by k alone. Actual completed whole reviews reconstruct the same finite endpoint construction in the corrected root Section7.

Arbitrary finite quantum references but only defined finite conditional-relative-entropy differences
For an explicit rational threshold witness, actual rational gap c*r_i<1 and paid support/gap bounds

assumptions: Exact supplied finite density matrices, n>=2 CLASSICALlabels and exact supports are essential. B independently reconstructed the whole corrected root proof; C also whole-reviewed while disclosing prior contribution, not a blind review. The actual source-first Choi vector is vec(conjugate Z). Arbitrarily small full-rank contamination gives r=0, so the universal reverse factor is not robust under unrestricted channel uncertainty. The extraction effects are not a jointly normalized physical POVM. No arbitrary pairwise CQnecessity, channel acquisition, privacy/capacity, unchanged multi-use factor, physical inverse, practical advantage or priority is acquired.
